description: Validation settings for a signing field.

members.name: Max
members.description: Maximum numeric/date value or maximum length depending on field type.

members.name: Message
members.description: Custom validation message displayed when validation fails.

members.name: Messages
members.description: Localized validation messages displayed when validation fails.

members.name: Min
members.description: Minimum numeric/date value or minimum length depending on field type.

members.name: Pattern
members.description: Regular expression pattern for text-like fields.
